examples.name: ReadOnly
examples.summary: A read-only certificate keeps the filled look, drops the hover border and reads in the code face (`monospace`); the field description says why the value cannot change.

examples.name: Monospace
examples.summary: A zone-file paste box: `monospace` draws the records in the code face, so columns and characters read as code; `:spellcheck="false"` keeps the browser from flagging record names.
